title: A Horizon for the Signal
author: Rosalind Thornbury
blurb: Xanthe Okonkwo, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
